policy: Source pages are bibliographic citation records (title, authors, journal, year, DOI). Since 2026-09-25 every /source/* page defaults to noindex, follow and is excluded from sitemap.xml, so Google's crawl budget goes to the 717 articles. Pages stay publicly reachable, keep their self-canonical and 'Claim or review this work' workflow, and pass link equity via follow. Only sources listed in indexableSources (keystone sources with a substantive source-specific 'why keystone' explanation) stay indexable. Add a source to indexableSources only after substantive source explanation or accepted public context is published. citationOnlySources is retained as the 2026-09-21 reviewed record and always wins over indexableSources.
